description: A business process flow on one table: its stages in order, each with the columns users fill in. Written with SDK messages, so it works online and on-premises. The stages replace the flow's stages. See the guide dyno://guides/business-process-flows.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the flow, and the table that holds its progress, go into.

name.description: The flow's name; an existing business process flow matches by name.

table.description: Logical name of the table the flow runs on. Cannot change. Business process flows are turned on for the table if they are not yet; that cannot be undone.

stages.description: The stages, in the order a record moves through them. Needed for a new flow. A stage keeps its id (and the records at it) when its name stays the same.

name.description: The stage name, unique in the flow.

steps.description: The data steps, in order. A stage may have none.

column.description: Logical name of a column on the flow's table.

label.description: Text shown for the step. Default: the column's display name, or the current label.

required.description: The step must have a value before the record moves to the next stage. Default false, or the current setting.

state.description: active or draft. Default: a new flow is active, an existing one keeps its state.
